profile.headline: Staff Embedded Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a Firmware / Software Architect and Lead Engineer with a strong focus on safety-critical and high-reliability systems. Throughout my career I have prioritized scalable, robust architectures across robotics, automotive, medical devices, audio, telecom, and radar — from bare-metal firmware on ARM and DSP platforms to PC-side software on Windows, Linux, QNX, and Android.

I am passionate about merging industry best practices in the safety-critical domain with modern, developer-friendly paradigms. Today that means actively integrating agentic coding into my SDLC — using AI-assisted tools to accelerate design, implementation, and testing cycles while preserving the rigor these domains demand.

My goal is to enable fast-moving teams to build safe, reliable software without sacrificing velocity or flexibility.
